question.text: Non-deposit taking NBFCs with asset size of what minimum threshold and above are permitted to participate in designated currency options exchanges as clients for hedging their underlying forex exposures?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 201, non-deposit taking applicable NBFCs with asset size of Rs. 500 crore and above are allowed to participate in designated currency options exchanges recognised by SEBI as clients, only for the purpose of hedging their underlying forex exposures. The Trap: The Rs. 500 crore asset-size threshold is specific to options participation. Note: For currency futures, page 201 indicates that applicable NBFCs may participate as clients for hedging; the Rs. 500 crore asset-size cut-off is the additional condition that applies in the options segment.
